name: Tragedy
overview: Scripture reveals that tragedy often touches the brokenhearted and the righteous, yet God draws near to those who are contrite and provides strength and refuge in times of trouble. The Lord promises to uphold and help His people, offering comfort by binding up the brokenhearted and proclaiming liberty to the captive. Even when the righteous perish, it is understood that they are taken away from coming evil, underscoring God's sovereign care amid suffering.
